headline: Anthropic reports five cases of AI use in dual-use biological research
summary: Anthropic’s 10 September 2026 threat-intelligence report describes five cases in which users or model-routing intermediaries used Claude in dual-use biological research. The company says some requests were blocked or limited to less capable models, while other computational and writing assistance proceeded. Anthropic does not claim the scientists intended harm, and it reports no resulting biological weapon or harmful experimental outcome. The cases are selected provider reports, not a representative sample or independent measurement of model uplift.
